headline: On October 23, 2001: Apple releases the iPod
captionCards: iPod could store up to 1,000 songs
iPod's legacy lives on in smartphones
instagramCaption:
Apple changes the music industry forever. \\[Blank Line] On October 23, 2001, Apple Computer, founded by Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak, released the iPod, a revolutionary portable music player. The device, with its sleek design and innovative features, quickly became a cultural icon. Surprisingly, it could store up to 1,000 songs, transforming how people listened to music. Today, the iPod's legacy continues in modern smartphones and streaming services. \\[Blank Line] What was your first iPod like? \\[Blank Line] Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
